properties.displayName: SCF-Manual attestation for enforcing account lockout, rate-limiting, risk-based conditional access, and strong password policies
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm that account lockout thresholds and rate-limiting controls to block repeated failed login attempts are enforced. Conditional access policies based on risk signals (e.g., location, device, IP reputation) are configured using cloud-native tools. Strong, complex passwords must be required, and password reuse must be prohibited by leveraging cloud-native password protection features.
